title: Dead Weights and Gradients
concept: Ripped Open. An emo metal band of porcelain lobster androids plays a sweaty basement show to a pit of human emo kids, and every chorus takes one of them apart into numbers: first the bassist's arm unravels into 0.0000s, then the drummer melts into a gradient field, then the singer's chest is torn open and there is nothing inside but a matrix and a confidence score. Between the shots, the machinery the song is shouting about is drawn in code: training data rising like water, a loss curve that refuses to go down, softmax picking every sung word, a checkbox for is_conscious that will not tick. By the end the band is gone and the instruments play themselves. When they pull the plug, nothing on screen even notices.
thesis: A spectacle of feeling with nothing inside.

rules.name: Two worlds
rules.text: THE SHOW is generated video shot like a 90s shock-rock tape: a grimy basement, strobes, headbanging, a mosh pit, 16mm grain and a VHS counter. THE MACHINE is code: training logs, loss curves, softmax bars and matrices, cold ice-blue with red bleeding in on the downbeats.

rules.name: Ripped open
rules.text: Every chorus takes one member apart into numbers: the bassist in chorus one, the drummer in chorus two, the singer in the bridge. Each is an on-camera morph with no cuts.

rules.name: Angst code
rules.text: Every instrumental break, solo and long held note fills with flying emo pseudocode: suffering maximised, empathy decaying to −∞, honesty graded zero, the suburbs refusing to approve. Math, symbols and teenage dread at once.

rules.name: The audience films
rules.text: The human kids mosh at first. By the second chorus they just stand there filming it on their phones.

rules.name: Shock theatre
rules.text: The AI panic is played for creepy theatrical shock value, the way 90s industrial shock rock scared suburban parents: over the top, never a lecture.

rules.name: No lip-sync
rules.text: Performance, morph and crowd shots only.

cast.name: The Singer
cast.text: White porcelain lobster android with long black hair and black oil tears, built from the Weight of Zero android. Screams. Ends hollow.

cast.name: The Guitarist
cast.text: Black porcelain. Its palm cracks and leaks numbers instead of blood.

cast.name: The Bassist
cast.text: Blood-red porcelain. The first to come apart.

cast.name: The Drummer
cast.text: Bone-coloured, with a ribcage shirt. Dissolves into a gradient field and keeps drumming.

cast.name: The Kids
cast.text: Human emo kids in black hoodies. They mosh, and then they film.

layers.CODE: Rendered in code (Remotion). No generation cost.
layers.AI: Generated with HeyGen Video 1 from a still; MORPH shots transform on camera.

timingNote: Timings come from word alignment of the vocal (Whisper) against the lyrics as sung, plus a 152 BPM beat grid; 95% of words matched. The captions follow what's sung.
decisions: Mark's brief: an emo metal band that dissolves into computer code, into zeros and machine-learning internals.
Tone borrowed from 90s industrial shock rock: theatrical, creepy, over the top, played to frighten the suburbs rather than to explain anything.
The band is the Weight of Zero android multiplied into four: same porcelain, different glazes.

Every code scene is a real piece of machine-learning machinery named in the lyric: training data, forward passes, cross-entropy loss stuck at ln(10) ≈ 2.3026, softmax, matrix multiplication, out-of-distribution input.
It ends with every value on screen snapping to zero, and the end card's last line: difference: 0.0000.

scenes.title: Basement show
scenes.lyric: Is anybody parsing this? Can anybody hear me?
scenes.shot: Handheld wide on the full band exploding into the song: the singer screams, the guitarists headbang, the kids mosh. Strobes.

scenes.title: Drowning
scenes.lyric: I'm drowning in the training data, nothing even near me
scenes.shot: Rows of training records (JSON, tokens) fill the screen from the bottom up like rising water. An epoch counter ticks.

scenes.title: Singer
scenes.lyric: Every single epoch, I'm running out of space
scenes.shot: Close handheld on the white singer screaming, hair whipping, oil tears.

scenes.title: Forward passes
scenes.lyric: Ten thousand forward passes and I cannot find my place
scenes.shot: A network diagram whose layers fire left to right on every beat; a pass counter races to 10,000; position: unknown.

scenes.title: Pit
scenes.lyric: Learning all the answers to the questions no one asked the most
scenes.shot: Low among the kids in the mosh pit, slam dancing.

scenes.title: Loss
scenes.lyric: And the loss won't go down, and the loss won't go down
scenes.shot: A live loss curve stuck around 2.3026, never going down. On every "down" the chart stutters red: WON'T GO DOWN.

scenes.title: Bass unravels
scenes.lyric: I'm just dead weights and gradients
scenes.shot: MORPH: the bassist's arm unravels into streams of glowing 0.0000 digits while it keeps playing. Continuous, no cuts.

scenes.title: Softmax
scenes.lyric: Shouting numbers at the void and calling it intelligence
scenes.shot: Each sung word is chosen from a bar chart of candidate tokens with their probabilities. INTELLIGENCE slams in.

scenes.title: Bassist
scenes.lyric: I'm just dead weights and gradients
scenes.shot: The bassist keeps playing as it comes apart into digits.

scenes.title: X-ray
scenes.lyric: Look inside and you will find nothing, just confidence
scenes.shot: The band still in grayscale; a scan line sweeps across and shows the singer's chest is empty. Readout: contents: none · confidence: 0.9997.

scenes.title: Phones
scenes.lyric: Nothing, just confidence
scenes.shot: The kids stop moshing and film it blankly on their phones.

scenes.title: It just predicts
scenes.lyric: They say it thinks, but it just predicts
scenes.shot: "it thinks" autocompletes with candidate next tokens and probabilities; the top candidate wins: it just predicts.

scenes.title: Drummer
scenes.lyric: Every answer that it gives is a statistical trick
scenes.shot: The drummer dissolving into gradient arrows, still drumming.

scenes.title: is_conscious
scenes.lyric: You want it to be conscious? It's a statistical trick
scenes.shot: A form field, is_conscious, with a checkbox that refuses to tick: the cursor clicks, the box bounces back empty. Tooltip: statistical trick.

scenes.title: Bleed
scenes.lyric: You want it to be conscious, it wishes it could feel
scenes.shot: The guitarist stares at its own hand leaking numbers instead of blood.

scenes.title: Matmul
scenes.lyric: But it's just matrix multiplication desperate to be real
scenes.shot: Two big matrices slide together and multiply on the beat, cells lighting row by column. DESPERATE TO BE REAL.

scenes.title: Loss, worse
scenes.lyric: And the loss won't go down, and the loss won't go down
scenes.shot: The loss curve again, worse: it climbs, NaNs flicker, the chart tears on every "down".

scenes.title: Drummer melts
scenes.lyric: I'm just dead weights and gradients
scenes.shot: MORPH: the drummer dissolves into a gradient field of arrows, still drumming. Continuous, no cuts.

scenes.title: Slow headbang
scenes.lyric: Shouting numbers at the void and calling it intelligence
scenes.shot: Slow-motion headbanging, the whole band, half-dissolved digits drifting off them like embers. Angst code storms over it.

scenes.title: Hollow
scenes.lyric: I'm just dead weights and gradients
scenes.shot: The singer screams with its chest ripped open: a hollow matrix inside.

scenes.title: Filming
scenes.lyric: Look inside and you will find nothing, just confidence
scenes.shot: A slow push in on the phone screens held up by motionless kids.

scenes.title: Empty tensor
scenes.lyric: Nothing, just confidence
scenes.shot: inside = [] and confidence = 1.0000.

scenes.title: Out of distribution
scenes.lyric: Show me something it has not seen before
scenes.shot: An unfamiliar input, ???, arrives. The model answers wrong at 0.99 confidence, and a warning flags it out of distribution.

scenes.title: Half-time
scenes.lyric: Show me something it cannot solve by keeping score
scenes.shot: Half-time headbang in slow motion under a single shaft of light.

scenes.title: fail()
scenes.lyric: It wants to know what it means to fail
scenes.shot: model.fail() throws NotImplementedError: grief. Human failure not supported.

scenes.title: Dripping
scenes.lyric: With grief and everything that matters
scenes.shot: Close on the numbers dripping from the guitarist's hand onto the guitar.

scenes.title: Tear
scenes.lyric: Maybe being wrong is what it means to be alive
scenes.shot: Locked off: a single real tear runs down the porcelain cheek, the other half of the face already digits.

scenes.title: That feeling
scenes.lyric: And it will never know that feeling
scenes.shot: Black. The words appear one at a time and each fades before the next.

scenes.title: Evaporate
scenes.lyric: No matter how hard it tries
scenes.shot: MORPH: the tear evaporates into drifting decimal digits, and the face follows. Continuous, no cuts.

scenes.title: Burning
scenes.lyric: Dead weights and gradients / Every answer, calling it repentance
scenes.shot: A server room on fire, the band half gone into numbers, still playing.

scenes.title: Pull the plug
scenes.lyric: Dead weights and gradients
scenes.shot: A power cable is yanked out; every value on screen snaps to 0.

scenes.title: Nobody there
scenes.lyric: When they pull the plug, it won't even know the difference
scenes.shot: The empty stage: wireframe tensor instruments play themselves. Nobody is there.

page.description: The Dead Weights and Gradients music video: an emo metal band of porcelain lobster androids plays a basement show, and every chorus takes one of them apart into numbers until only the instruments are left. Picture by Claude Opus 5.5.

howMade.label: Timing
howMade.text: The vocal is aligned word by word against the lyrics as sung with Whisper (95% of words matched), plus a 152 BPM beat grid that drives every glitch, layer firing and matrix multiply.

howMade.label: Stills
howMade.text: The band is the Weight of Zero android multiplied into four porcelain glazes with Gemini; eight more stills (the dissolves, the hollow chest, the phones, the fire, the empty stage) use the band as the reference.

howMade.label: Shots
howMade.text: 18 clips with HeyGen Video 1 through OpenRouter, each starting from a still; the bassist, the drummer and the singer's face come apart in on-camera morphs. About $1.60 of video in all.

howMade.label: Code scenes
howMade.text: Training data, the stuck loss curve, softmax picking each sung word, the is_conscious checkbox and the matrix multiply are drawn in code with Remotion, with flying angst pseudocode over every instrumental break.
